limitations: Complete accepted byte language for the fresh storage-value reader, not the general cached-marker deserializer API.
Value bytes are supplied by caller; runtime key prefix, database behavior, RPC JSON, full EVM behavior and persistence are not implemented.
Successful value and consumed prefix are reconstructed; local rejection type excludes native error allocation/text, failure cursor, panic/allocator and unwind behavior.
Native helpers and string validation are statically inspected. Rust core UTF8 validation and Python codec comparisons are offline references, not target execution.
No captured target execution or emulation, signing, live network, acceptance gate change or issue closure.
